div.div: 1 مَا زَالَ يَهِيطُ , inf. n. هَيْطٌ; and مَا زَالَ فِى هَيْطٍ وَمَيْطٍ; He ceased not to be engaged in crying out, or vociferating, or calling for aid or succour; and in evil, or mischief; and raising a clamour, or confused noise. (K.) IKtt says, that يهيط has no pret. (TA.) [See also 3.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
